notes.title: DEMO has been released!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone[/b]

I would like to invite you to try out the [b]DEMO [/b]of my project [b]Dreadborne Dungeon[/b].

[b]In short, what is Dreadborne Dungeon[/b].

Dreadborne Dungeon is a stylized pixel art shooter that transports you to a retro world inspired by classics like Doom and Heretic. I've always been a huge fan of these titles, so I wanted to create something that captures the spirit of those games while also introducing mechanics borrowed from Souls-like games, which I'm also a big fan of.

I would really appreciate it if you give a chance to my game, check it out and give me feedback.

The final game shape will be based on all opinions.

I also would like to invite you to the game dedicated discord server [url=https://discord.gg/gVRJH8p69b]https://discord.gg/gVRJH8p69b
[/url]
Many thanks!
